name: validate_dod
description: Run the Bubbles state-transition guard against a spec dir. Validates DoD evidence (markdown OR tool-log), scope status, transition gates, and returns the full guard output (stdout + stderr + exit code) verbatim. Use when an agent claims a spec/scope is 'done' and you need machine-verifiable proof. Read-only by construction: the guard's --revert-on-fail state rewrite is deliberately NOT exposed here, because certification state is bubbles.validate-owned and a model-invocable status rewrite is a forging vector. Use the CLI when a revert is genuinely intended.

spec_dir.description: Spec directory relative to repo root, e.g. 'specs/045-foo'.
